verdict.rationale: Featurebase's feedback portal and public roadmap (docs-15, docs-19) imply PMs can move feedback into planned/shipped states, and webhooks (docs-1, docs-24, docs-29) plus generic 'connect your favorite tools' integrations (docs-4) could push feedback into external task trackers.
